acceptance: A claude transcript fixture with 3 turns gives 3 lines in time order, each with its counts and tool names.
The cycle-1967 agy fixture gives 111 lines whose sum equals the row of the call.
A call above the line cap writes the cap and a truncated count.
When the turn sum differs from the row, a WARN fires and the row is not changed.
A turn write failure warns and never fails the launch.
fix: Return the usage of each turn from the collectors in tokenusage.Result (Turns: index, timestamp, the four counts, prompt tokens, tool names). The claude scanner reads the tool_use names of each assistant message; the agy collector gives one turn for each generation. The bridge appends one line for each turn to <run dir>/llm-turns.ndjson, keyed by call_id, with a line cap for each call and a truncated count.
source: console, 2026-10-27, operator request: "identify which phase or agent or steps burning the most tokens". Plan docs/plans/token-telemetry-2026-10.md; research docs/research/token-telemetry-2026-10.md
summary: A turn sidecar llm-turns.ndjson records the tokens, the tool names and the context size of each turn. Plan docs/plans/token-telemetry-2026-10.md component T3.
